Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on your itinerary from June 10-20, 2024:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (for beach days at Waikiki and Kailua, snorkeling at Hanauma Bay)
- Sunscreen (high SPF recommended for tropical sun)
- Hiking gear (comfortable shoes, hat, water bottle for Diamond Head hike)
- Casual outfits (for daily activities and North Shore road trip)
- Camera (to capture memories at Pearl Harbor, beaches, and cultural sites)
- Travel documents (ID, passport if needed, hotel confirmations, flight details)

Additional Recommended Items:
- Light rain jacket (for potential showers)
- Reef-safe sunscreen (required for Hanauma Bay)
- Beach towel
- Sunglasses and hat
- Insect repellent
- Reusable water bottle
- Snorkeling gear (optional, can be rented)
- Formal attire (if needed for any special dinners)
- Chargers for electronic devices
- First aid kit with basic medications
- Cash and credit cards

Special Notes:
- Pack light clothing suitable for warm, humid weather
- Include one nicer outfit for the Luau experience on June 16
- Don't forget comfortable walking shoes for Pearl Harbor visit and shopping day
- Spa day on June 17 might require bringing a swimsuit if using pool facilities
